more, {01 00 00 05 00}don't you?

{07 0c 00}{01 00 00 14 00}Oh!{01 00 00 05 00} {07 14 00}Oh! Oh! I know!{01 00 00 14 00}{07 0b 00} Can I{01 00 00 0a 00}

messages.et:
{07 0e 00}Arvan, et peaksime rohkem
koos aega veetma, {01 00 00 05 00}kas sa ei
leia?
{07 0c 00}{01 00 00 14 00}Oh!{01 00 00 05 00} {07 14 00}Oh! Oh! Ma tean!{01 00 00 14 00}{07 0b 00} Kas ma{01 00 00 0a 00}
võiksin kunagi sinu

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Hey, {04 1f 00}, I've
always wondered what kind
of a house you live in.
{07 15 00}You play it like you're all
casual, {01 00 00 05 00}{07 11 00}but I bet your
house is awesome!
{07 0f 00}But this is all just
speculation, 'cause you've
never invited me over!
{07 00 00}So whaddaya say? {07 0b 00}Can I
come by and see your
place, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Hei, {04 1f 00}, olen alati
mõelnud, millises majas
sa elad.
{07 15 00}Sa teed nägu, nagu oleks
kõik lihtne, {01 00 00 05 00}{07 11 00}aga vean kihla,
et su maja on vinge!
{07 0f 00}Aga see on kõik ainult
oletus, sest sa pole mind
kunagi külla kutsunud!
{07 00 00}Mis sa kostad? {07 0b 00}Kas ma
võin läbi tulla ja su
kodu vaadata, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Having someone visit your
house is proof that they're
your friend, huh?
{07 06 00}I'd sure like to see your
place, too, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.{01 01 00}
{ff 00 00 04}Hint, hint.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Kellegi külla kutsumine on
tõend, et ta on sinu
sõber, mis?
{07 06 00}Tahaksin väga näha ka
sinu kodu, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.{01 01 00}
{ff 00 00 04}Vihje, vihje.
